subject: On-prem deployment validation & kickoff plan
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudmedhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@cloudmedhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem deployment validation & kickoff plan

Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We need to lock down a slightly more formal plan and evidence package before our security and procurement teams will sign off on an air-gapped on‑prem deployment. Specifically, they have asked for:

- A proposed kickoff and test schedule (preferred dates for rollout and validation)
- A single ZIP of operational artifacts: install runbook, network diagram, firewall rules, HA/DR runbook, and patching policy
- Proof of attestation for offline bootstrap and HSM/KMS integration (screenshots or short video acceptable)
- Clarification on what telemetry (if any) is sent out and how logs can be ingested into our SIEM
- A contact matrix for escalation during the deployment window

Can you confirm you can deliver the above by next Thursday (2026-09-10)? We plan to present to our InfoSec committee on 2026-09-16.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Director, Infrastructure Operations
CloudMed Health

Attachment: RFP_Exhibit_A.pdf (pdf, 480KB)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment validation & kickoff plan

Team — looping you in to coordinate a concise evidence package and a kickoff schedule for CloudMed. High level proposed plan below; please reply with ownership and ETA.

Proposed plan (short):
1) Internal prep & artifact assembly (owner: Vanessa) — deliver by 2026-09-09 EOD
2) Draft deployment kickoff calendar & runbook summary (owner: Priyom) — deliver by 2026-09-09 EOD
3) Legal/contract check for data residency and attestation language (owner: Marissa) — review by 2026-09-10
4) Send consolidated package to CloudMed and propose kickoff call on 2026-09-15 or 2026-09-16 (owner: Jonas)

Key asks for artifacts: runbook (install + rollback), network diagram, firewall rule sets (examples), HSM/KMS integration notes, telemetry opt-out steps, and a short escalation contact list. Keep items short — InfoSec prefers one-pagers + a single evidence ZIP.

Vanessa — can you collate the runbook snippets and the network diagram?
Priyom — can you produce a 1-2 page install summary and a brief note on bootstrap (airgap) flow and expected lead time for hardware prep?
Marissa — quick legal review of any attestation language we include.

I'll own the outreach to CloudMed and schedule the kickoff.\nRegards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 18:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment validation & kickoff plan

Jonas — I will assemble the artifact bundle. Initial inventory (I will upload to the shared folder):

- redwood_onprem_playbook_v1.3.pdf — playbook with install steps, rollback, and patch cadence (one pager per section)
- network_diagram_cloudmed.png — sample diagram with required subnets, NAT, and LAN segmentation notes
- firewall_rules_example.txt — example iptables / Palo Alto snippet (redact customer IPs)
- attestation_screenshots.zip — HSM key import screenshots + KMS config (sanitized)
- telemetry_control.md — how to disable any outbound telemetry + list of endpoints we call (if any)
- escalation_matrix.csv — primary/secondary contacts for install and ops

ETA: I will have the first-pass bundle uploaded to the Drive link by 2026-09-09 11:00 PT. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDACTED

Notes: the attestation screenshots are small; if they need a video walkthrough we can do a short recording during the kickoff. Also, the playbook references our standard image versions (RL-1.7). Priyom — can you confirm that is acceptable or recommend a minimal image matrix for their hardware?\n—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Delivery Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudmedhealth.com>, procurement <procurement@cloudmedhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment validation & kickoff plan — consolidated package and proposed dates

Samira — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a consolidated evidence package and a proposed kickoff/test calendar. Highlights below; full artifacts are attached and in the Drive link.

Proposed calendar:
- 2026-09-15 09:00 PT — Kickoff & walkthrough (60 min)
- 2026-09-22 — Staging install window (non-production)
- 2026-09-29 — Production readiness validation (smoke tests, HA failover test)

What we included:
- redwood_onprem_playbook_v1.3.pdf (playbook and one-page sections)
- network_diagram_cloudmed.png (logical network + required NAT routes)
- attestation_screenshots.zip (HSM import + KMS binding)
- telemetry_control.md (endpoints, opt-out steps)
- escalation_matrix.csv (primary contacts and phone/pager numbers)

Security clarifications (short):
- Offline bootstrap: support for USB-based image import and signed manifests; no outbound internet required during install except for optional license activation (we can provide an offline license file).
- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports PKCS#11 HSMs for key storage and can integrate with customer key material. We include screenshots of the KMS binding and automated key rotation guidelines (in attestation zip).
- Telemetry & logs: by default we do not send application logs to Redwood. Metrics for health and usage are configurable; we can disable external metrics entirely and provide an S3/SharePoint-compatible log export for ingestion into customer SIEM.

Next steps: please confirm 2026-09-15 09:00 PT or propose an alternate time. If InfoSec needs a video walkthrough of the attestation steps, we can record a 10-minute clip during the kickoff and upload it to the Drive.

Attachments: redwood_onprem_playbook_v1.3.pdf, network_diagram_cloudmed.png, attestation_screenshots.zip

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudmedhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, procurement <procurement@cloudmedhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment validation & kickoff plan — consolidated package and proposed dates

Jonas / team,

Thanks — the package looks good and concise, exactly what InfoSec asked for. We can confirm the kickoff for 2026-09-15 09:00 PT. A couple of quick clarifications so we can finalize the sign-off: 

1) Version matrix — can you confirm the exact image tag and the minimal supported kernel for the RL-1.7 reference? We will need that noted in the install runbook.
2) Planned downtime — the customer wants an estimate of the expected service interruption window during the production cutover (expected minutes/hours).

If you can add those two items to the Drive by EOD 2026-09-11 we will present to the committee on 2026-09-16. Otherwise we may ask for a short recorded walkthrough of the HSM steps during the kickoff.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Infrastructure Operations
CloudMed Health
